name: Etsuko Mobile v1.3.0 — Smart Autoplay & YouTube ML Radio
body:
### ⚡ What's New in v1.3.0:
- **Real Smart Autoplay:** YouTube Music ML Radio (`RDAMVM`) context-aware queue without repeated titles.
- **Zero-Silence Offline Audio:** VisionOS direct unthrottled AAC audio stream extraction with real sound playback.
- **High-Speed Chunked Downloader:** Parallel 256KB range chunks downloading in ~2.2s.
- **Resilient Auto-Update Engine:** Dual-channel check (Fastly CDN raw JSON + GitHub API) with native APK download & package installation.
- **Skip Tracker & Anti-Repetition Diversity Filter:** Keeps recommendations fresh and varied.
